- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Mammoth Tribe worships animal spirits, including Arktouros (The Great Bear), Agrios (The Wild Boar), Skorpios (The Scorpion), Toxotes (The Archer Fish), Ophin (The Serpent), Keravnos (The Thunderbolt), Hydor (The Water), and Chelona (The Turtle).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Arktouros is associated with strength, protection, and endurance; Agrios symbolizes ferocity and determination; Skorpios represents stealth and cunning; Toxotes is linked to precision and focus; Ophin signifies transformation and regeneration; Keravnos embodies power and energy; Hydor is connected to life and vitality; Chelona symbolizes longevity and wisdom.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The marriage ceremony of the Mammoth Tribe is overseen by shamans and includes exchanging vows, receiving gifts, performing blessings, and drinking from a shared vessel filled with a special elixir.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The couple is dressed in their finest clothes made from mammoth hides, and the ceremony is celebrated with a feast that may last several days.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The coming of age ceremony for young hunters involves a special hunting expedition, preparatory rituals, blessings, and a celebration upon their return with spoils.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Young hunters are painted with sacred designs, receive blessings from shamans, and are tasked with tracking and preparing game during the hunt.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The ceremony to appease an angered mammoth spirit involves prayers, offerings, magical artifacts, and divination practices performed by a shaman.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The shaman recites prayers, uses special stones or crystals, and offers gifts such as food or drink to the spirit to restore balance and harmony.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A sample prayer for the ritual includes asking for forgiveness, offering gifts, and expressing reverence for the mammoth spirit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The greatest hunter of the Mammoth Tribe is a young woman named Saren, known for her exceptional skills in tracking and capturing mammoths.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Saren was trained by her father, a renowned hunter, and has been hunting since childhood, combining physical skills with spiritual practices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Saren is a role model for young hunters and participates in the tribe's ceremonies, maintaining a deep connection to animal spirits.
